dedupe_keys.name: dominican republic apartment appliance demand and power quality measurements

description: This collection records electrical demand and power-quality characteristics of seventeen household appliances measured in an apartment in San Cristóbal, Dominican Republic. Loyola researchers used a Fluke 1738 analyser and prepared minute-level average, minimum and maximum values, usually from a one-hour test. Variables include power, current, power factor and voltage and current harmonic distortion. Mendeley version 2 lists Excel tables, text exports and native FCA2 files, available free under CC BY 4.0. The producer’s workflow also mentions CSV export, but the inspected inventory does not establish a separately released CSV collection. Coverage is limited to selected appliances and operating states in one apartment, with no representative annual household schedule. A reviewer-assessed use is building appliance-level load shapes or checking backup-power sizing assumptions in residential simulations. data-refit-smart-homes-uk is a related longer household monitoring collection. The measurements were not downloaded, and native-file software requirements were not tested.
